description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, comparing three different gating conditions at a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03" is represented by a blue dashed line without markers. It begins at approximately 0.18 at layer 0, drops sharply to roughly 0.03 by layer 2, and maintains a steady, near-zero trend for the remainder of the x-axis, ending at approximately 0.0 at layer 23. The "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44" is shown as an orange dotted line without markers. It starts at approximately 0.98 at layer 0, exhibits a steady decline to about 0.47 at layer 7, and continues to drop to roughly 0.29 at layer 10. Between layers 13 and 20, it fluctuates between 0.18 and 0.28, before showing a sharp peak at approximately 0.4 at layer 21, a drop to 0.23 at layer 22, and ending at roughly 0.39 at layer 23. Finally, the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33" is depicted by a green dash-dot line without markers. It begins at 1.0 at layer 0 and follows a declining trend, reaching approximately 0.36 at layer 7 and 0.18 at layer 10. It continues a gradual decline with minor fluctuations, hitting roughly 0.09 at layer 15, showing a minor peak at 0.11 at layer 21, and concluding at approximately 0.04 at layer 23.
